workflow.name: TM1 Dimension & Cube Creation
workflow.description: Create TM1 dimensions with elements/attributes and cubes using TurboIntegrator processes
workflow.when_to_use: User needs to create dimensions, cubes, or load data from CSV files; building new TM1 models

learning.description: Create dimensions, elements, attributes, cube, and load data in ONE comprehensive TI process
learning.rationale: Ensures all dependencies are met before data loading; eliminates "Invalid key" errors from missing elements
learning.anti_pattern: Creating dimensions in one process, then loading data in another (causes missing element errors)

learning.description: Never assume dimension elements exist - always use DimensionElementInsert for every element
learning.rationale: Dimension creation without element insertion creates empty dimensions, causing data load failures

learning.principle: Use Measures Dimension for Multi-Metric Cubes
learning.description: Create dedicated dimension for measures (e.g., Measures, Metrics) instead of separate cubes
learning.rationale: Makes cube structure cleaner, more flexible, and easier to query
learning.example: Sales_Measures: revenue, units_sold, discount, margin | HR_Measures: headcount, salary, bonus

learning.description: Always verify dimension elements exist before attempting to write data to cube

error.solution: Always create elements before loading data; use DimIx to verify

error.prevention: Never assume elements exist - always insert explicitly

error.message: Type mismatch when setting attribute value

error.message: Dimension doesn't exist when creating cube
error.cause: Trying to create cube before dimensions are created
error.solution: Create all dimensions before CubeCreate call
error.prevention: Follow PROLOG structure: dimensions → elements → attributes → cube

practice.name: Atomic Process Design
practice.description: Combine dimension creation, element insertion, and data loading in single process
practice.benefit: Ensures referential integrity; easier to rollback on failure

practice.name: Clean Slate Approach
practice.description: Use DimensionDeleteAllElements instead of deleting/recreating dimension
practice.benefit: Faster; preserves dimension metadata; ensures fresh start

practice.name: Explicit Element Creation
practice.description: Always use DimensionElementInsert for every element
practice.benefit: Prevents "Invalid key" errors; makes code self-documenting

practice.name: Validation Before Data Load
practice.description: Use DimIx to verify elements exist before CellPutN/CellPutS
practice.benefit: Catches missing elements early; provides clear error messages

practice.name: Use Measures Dimension
practice.description: Create dedicated dimension for metrics instead of separate cubes
practice.benefit: Cleaner structure; more flexible; easier to query

practice.name: Verify with MDX
practice.description: After loading data, query cube with MDX to verify correctness
practice.benefit: Confirms data loaded successfully; validates cube structure
